estimand: P(an individual plays another video of a creator within the next 7 days | it played a video of that creator today), including re-exposure by the production recommender

selection.rule: E4: among candidates with compute <= 100 us/row, order by the validation primary metric (ties within 1e-4 to the simpler); keep the first unless its validation long-horizon measure is worse than the smallest one with a paired cluster-bootstrap 95% interval of the difference entirely above 0; keep a simple baseline instead if it is strictly better on test
selection.reason: selected on validation and confirmed on test: no simple baseline is better

rule_comparison.mapping: no direct simulator rule: in the simulator repeat consumption of a creator arises from re-exposure plus the open rule's familiarity (+0.6) and following (+0.9) terms; the B1 familiarity baseline is its closest fitted analogue. The open rule itself, at affinity 0.2, sat 0.5 and a 120 s duration, gives one constant per-exposure probability, which is reported as P(at least one play in 7 days) assuming the user's own number of exposures to the author in the previous 7 days repeats

identification_note: Observational: the outcome mixes the recommender's re-exposure and the individual's choice; feature effects are associations.
extrapolation_limits: KuaiRand-Pure: 27,285 users of the Kuaishou short-video app (China), featured feed, 2022-04-08..05-08. The simulator may use this model for the probability that an individual who consumed a creator's item today consumes another item of the same creator within 7 days, given its familiarity, follow and like signals and both sides' activity. It may NOT infer: (1) the individual's preference net of exposure (re-exposure by the production recommender and by follow feeds is part of the outcome); (2) item-level repeat consumption (rare in the data); (3) other platforms, content kinds or periods; (4) horizons other than 7 days; plays count only pool videos.
